headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Consolidated GAAP Revenue recognized across CS-3 hardware systems, cloud inference services, and customer engineering support.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Consolidated GAAP Revenue ($M): Cerebras generated $180.11M in Q2 2026 (+74.32% YoY vs $103.32M in Q2 2025). Street consensus expects GAAP EPS of -$0.14 for Q3 2026E with buy-side whisper bogeys anticipating -$0.10 per share as non-cash stock compensation normalizes.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Remaining Performance Obligations and multi-year contracted backlog for CS-3 wafer-scale clusters and dedicated cloud compute capacity.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Contracted Backlog & RPO ($B): Cerebras ended 2025 with $24.6B in contracted backlog and commitments, led by multi-gigawatt G42 Condor Galaxy expansion and tier-1 frontier AI labs. Institutional consensus models RPO reaching $26.50B in Q3 2026E, with whisper bogeys stretching toward $28.00B.

headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_title: Peak sustained inference speed for Llama 3.1 70B/405B models measured in tokens per second per user stream.
headline_and_company_kpis.tooltip_def: Cerebras Cloud Inference Output (Tokens/Sec): Wafer-Scale Engine 3 delivers unmatched memory bandwidth, generating over 1,800 tokens/sec on Llama 3.1 8B and 450 tokens/sec on Llama 3.1 70B—orders of magnitude faster than conventional GPU server clusters. Consensus expects cloud API volume to surge >200% QoQ.
